name: Knucklespike Valor
description: Open with both claws held apart at the shoulders so each hand covers the line the other leaves bare.

name: Punishing Fingerblade
description: Rake with both claws down side by side so the two scores run parallel across the target.

name: Talonflash
description: Glide in a low curve with the arms spread and close on the opponent without ever lifting the heels.

name: Gust Clawbase
description: Cross both wrists in front of the face and let the claw backs take and turn a heavy swing.

name: Gyvenail
description: Slide both sets of tines beneath the opponent's forearm and lift it as a pair so the elbow cannot drop.

name: Gust Raze
description: Beat the guard aside with the left claw and rake through the opening with the right in one count.

name: Toxin Clawtip
description: Hook both of the opponent's guarding wrists and pry them apart with a sudden flare of qi.

name: Mightnail
description: Bring both claws down on one point at once so the field behind them splits whatever stands there.

name: Mastering Rip
description: Lock one claw at the shoulder and one at the elbow with qi so the arm is pinned and the body follows.

name: Dazzling Tinecurve
description: Vanish from one side of the opponent and reappear on the other in a breath with both claws already raking.

name: Talon Obduracy
description: Stand with the claws held low and wide like two banks so any blow must cross the channel between them.

name: Clawrake Reckoning
description: Rake with both hands in two flowing lines that run together like currents down the target's arm.

name: Mightpawl
description: Hop from one planted foot to the other in short sure steps as across stones in a stream.

name: Impenetrable Palmstrap
description: Turn the claw in a small circle against the blow like an eddy and spin it past the shoulder.

name: Wristband Vitality
description: Let the field lie on the opponent like still water and read each ripple his weight sends back.

name: Ponderous Hookclaw
description: Cross the hooked claws over the opponent's wrist as one wades a ford and hold him to the bank.

name: Blaze Shred
description: Pull the rake down the line of his own motion as a stream carries a leaf and score as he goes.

name: Mayhem Flay
description: Draw the hooked wrist round in a tight eddy until the opponent's grip is stripped away.

name: Ripscourge
description: Thrust the tines in a rush like water through rapids and drive them through the gap in his guard.

name: Tinecurve Havoc
description: Sweep the two claws together in a wide mouth that opens onto the target and tears across its whole front.

name: Ponderous Raze
description: Bear down through both claws like rising floodwater until the opponent's arms sink and his stance fails.

name: Hollowshred
description: Rake so the qi scours past armor and flesh alike and tears at the structure beneath.

name: Thorn Wristband
description: Reset the guard in a crouch after each stroke so the next stoop begins from a closed front.

name: Sanguine Knucklespike
description: Pin the near hand with one claw and open the exchange by raking the exposed forearm with the other.

name: Ghosting Shred
description: Pivot on the ball of the foot and slide behind the opponent's lead leg with the claws spread.

name: Suffocating Scour
description: Hook the opponent's front ankle and drag it forward so he is thrown from his steady perch.

name: Hoarfrost Backplate
description: Hook both of the opponent's wrists and bring them together against his belt until he cannot strike.

name: Hellish Scour
description: Fall from a crouch with the tines forward and stab down into the muscle above the collarbone.

name: Granite Clawrake
description: Rake from above in a stoop that ends with both claws set deep in the target's shoulders.

name: Shade Hookclaw
description: Press the seized arms apart and down together with a steady surge of qi so the chest stays open.

name: Adamantine Backplate
description: Catch a blow on the crossed claws and send its force back through the tines in one turning rake.

name: Unbudging Clawtip
description: Stand with the claws crossed low before the belly then rise to the ward that covers head and ribs together.

name: Flayscourge
description: Rake in a wide round arc like the rim of a basin that scores the target from hip to shoulder.

name: Gusttalon
description: Glide along the edge of the opponent's reach keeping the distance of one claw and the pair ready.

name: Unrelenting Talon
description: Roll the strike around the rim of the claw and shed it outward as water leaves a basin.

name: Veritynail
description: Hold both claws loose against the opponent's guard and read from the two touches which hand leads.

name: Maiming Rip
description: Hook two limbs of the opponent with the paired claws and tangle them across each other.

name: Gustpawl
description: Throw four quick slashes in an alternating beat so the guard is cut before it can close.

name: Mastering Fingerblade
description: Drive the claws between the opponent's forearms and spread them wide to open the face.

name: Clawtip Wrath
description: Narrow the field to a needle at the claw point and pierce through chainmail at the ribs.

name: Rumble Clawbase
description: Cross both claws through the target in an X that rends plate and cloth along both diagonals.

name: Shadepawl
description: Hold the opponent down with both claws and a spreading field that denies any motion of the arms.

name: Confluent Scour
description: Chain a hook then a hold then a rake across the paired claws so the whole exchange flows as one.

name: Dazzling Rumble Flay
description: Cross the distance in a blink with the claws trailing then rake as the opponent's eyes still seek the old place.

name: Facet Palmstrap
description: Hold the claws apart as two rivers run parallel and let each guard the line the other leaves.

name: Merciless Shred
description: Reach out with one claw alone and rake in a long clean line while the other hand rests guarding.

name: Torrent Clawbase
description: Bring both feet together on the center line as streams meet and push off again toward the flank.

name: Flintlike Wristband
description: Tilt the claw so a strike spills over its edge and falls away outside the guard.

name: Taloninsight
description: Look past the opponent's near hand to the far shoulder and read where the next stroke will start.

name: Talonspine
description: Bring both hooks together under the opponent's forearm and lift as one stream rising.

name: Punishing Tinecurve
description: Rake with both claws moving apart so the two lines open the body from the center outward.

name: Chime Clawrake
description: Draw the hooked wrist in a spiral that spins the opponent's arm out and around his own body.

name: Wrathful Hookclaw
description: Pour both streams of qi into one rake so it falls on the target as a torrent.

name: Charter Fingerblade
description: Hold both claws on the opponent like a rising tide and let the qi press until he cannot move.

name: Psyche Talon
description: Bring both streams into the one point of contact and tear through guard and body without regard to armor.

name: Unbudging Palmstrap
description: Sit the weight over the rear leg with the rending hand held back and the guarding hand forward.

name: Gnashing Rip
description: Slash with the rending hand along a track that runs parallel to the guarding forearm.

name: Granite Rip
description: Slide the feet apart and together with the arms flared like wings to close along a curve.

name: Unbudging Knucklespike
description: Cover with the guarding claw across the track and steer a blow onto the claw's outer edge.

name: Thornrip
description: Fold the two tracks into one hook and pull the opponent's arm across his chest.

name: Blaze Knucklespike
description: Cut twice in short strokes with the rending hand while the guarding hand holds the line.

name: Lacerating Backplate
description: Thrust the guarding claw forward unexpectedly so its tines pierce the armpit gap.

name: Might Flay
description: Rend armor along both tracks at once so the plates part at their joins and the flesh opens.

name: Ripdurance
description: Lock both tracks onto the opponent's weapon arm and hold it fast against the whole of his strength.

name: Wristband Insight
description: Draw the guarding track's qi into the striking claw so the next rake lands with far greater force.

name: Facet Talon
description: Root both feet on the ground as if sworn to it and raise the claws to cover the high line.

name: Sanguine Backplate
description: Rake in a stroke that is begun and finished as an oath is begun and finished without wavering.

name: Siltraze
description: Slide forward with the wind at the shoulder so the advance is quick and does not break the guard.

name: Palmstrap Nerve
description: Turn on the spot and sweep the claw across the front so the blow is turned and the stance holds.

name: Pawlrespite
description: Pause for one breath and read from the wind on the claws which way the opponent will shift.

name: Hoarfrost Scour
description: Set the hooks in the sleeve and draw the opponent along the line he must follow.

name: Pawlwrath
description: Rake across the front in a hard flat stroke that breaks the opponent's rhythm like a hard gust.

name: Chime Clawtip
description: Wrench the hooked wrist with all the strength of the oath until the weapon drops.

name: Hellish Raze
description: Rend down the whole length of the target in one long stroke driven by the weight of the oath.

name: Charter Clawbase
description: Bind the opponent with both claws and press down until he yields or the oath is released.

name: Impervious Fingerblade
description: Take the full blow on the claws without moving the feet and return its weight through the tines.

name: Pawlmettle
description: Stand with the toes near an imagined edge and hold the claws steady on a fixed bearing.

name: Rumble Clawrake
description: Rake exactly along the bearing taken so the stroke ends at the chosen point on the target.

name: Silt Flay
description: Slip one step to the side along the edge and keep the same bearing on the opponent's chest.

name: Ponderous Shred
description: Hook the opponent's arm along the bearing and hold it so he cannot move off the line.

name: Tempered Wristband
description: Slash across the bearing at the instant the opponent's front foot reaches the edge of his stance.

name: Equipoise Tinecurve
description: Parry on the bearing and draw the claw back through the opponent's forearm in the same motion.

name: Scourhavoc
description: Drop the rake from above onto the bearing like a stone falling over a cliff.

name: Maiming Knucklespike
description: Hold the claw on the bearing and let the qi push until the opponent cannot leave it.

name: Dazzling Scour Slipstream
description: Flash along the held bearing to the opponent's rear and rake before his guard can turn.

name: Iron Hookclaw
description: Set the feet in the gale and hold the sworn hand forward so the hooks lead into the wind.

name: Mangling Clawrake
description: Draw the hooked claw through the target in one smooth pull timed to the surge of the wind.

name: Vanishing Rip
description: Step through a gust without turning from the line so the oath of advance is kept.

name: Torrent Clawtip
description: Meet the blow with a gust-quick turn of the claw and send it off its path.

name: Hookclaw Vigil
description: Read the stirring of the air along the claws to know where the opponent's arm is moving.

name: Maiming Flay
description: Haul on the set hook with the surge of the wind behind it until the opponent comes forward.

name: Might Raze
description: Rake three times in the beat of three gusts so each stroke arrives as the guard shifts.

name: Fingerblade Durance
description: Spin the hook-held wrist round until the opponent's fingers open and let go.

name: Hollownail
description: Probe with the tines held thin as wind through a crack and find the gap in his armor.

name: Talonscourge
description: Haul the set hooks back with all the gale's weight and tear open what they hold.

name: Charter Raze
description: Pin the opponent under the sworn hand and let the gale press him flat against the ground.

name: Talonvigil
description: Draw the gale's push into the claw arm so the next rake lands far harder than the body could drive it.

name: Aegistalon
description: Take the guard in the open wind facing the foe and swear to hold that front.

name: Might Shred
description: Let the rake fall from the guard in a heavy arc that ends deep in the target's shoulder.

name: Granite Tinecurve
description: Advance with the wind at the back and the claws forward in long confident strides.

name: Murknail
description: Lean the body away and parry with the outer claw so the blow goes past by a finger's width.

name: Backplate Valor
description: Hook the arm and drag it down while the feet stay planted and the oath holds.

name: Tempered Palmstrap
description: Slash twice in one stride with the sworn hand leading and the second claw following the first.

name: Webbing Wristband
description: Press the hooked claw on the wrist and bear down until the opponent's strike falls apart.

name: Sanguine Palmstrap
description: Sunder the target with a stroke that has the open wind and the whole oath behind it.

name: Shade Talon
description: Hold both claws locked on the opponent's limbs so he cannot break away while qi flows.

name: Dismantling Knucklespike
description: Rake with a gale that passes armor and flesh and bites the very frame of the body.

name: Obdurate Clawbase
description: Stand with the shoulders squared on the bearing and the claws at the chest ready to move.

name: Rumblepawl
description: Rake down the held bearing so the claws follow the same line every time.

name: Unseen Shred
description: Slip sideways while the shoulders keep the bearing so the opponent faces a moving target on a fixed line.

name: Talonvalor
description: Sweep the claw across the bearing to turn a blow aside without losing the line.

name: Chimepawl
description: Feel along the claw at each contact whether the bearing is true and correct it by a finger.

name: Ponderous Tinecurve
description: Drag the hooked arm along the bearing so it carries the opponent's weight with it.

name: Might Clawtip
description: Slash in quick short strokes that all pass through the one bearing and so strike the same place.

name: Toxin Clawbase
description: Wrench the opponent's guard off the bearing with the hooks and leave the line clear.

name: Novatalon
description: Thrust a needle of qi along the bearing and through whichever plate stands on the line.

name: Blazeflay
description: Rake along the bearing with a force that tears through cloth hide and the plate beneath them.

name: Enthralling Talon
description: Press the claws down the bearing until the opponent's weight is pinned to the spot he stands on.

name: Multiplying Clawrake
description: Chain hook pull and rake along the one bearing so each stroke prepares the opponent for the next.

name: Shredvortex
description: Flash along the held bearing from far reach to a rake without the line breaking for an instant.

name: Talonnerve
description: Take the old plain stance of the plateau with the claws low and the weight settled behind them.

name: Raze Wrath
description: Draw the claw through with the lean economy of long practice so no motion is wasted.

name: Torrent Flay
description: Sidestep on the first push of a gust and let the opponent's charge go past.

name: Strangling Hookclaw
description: Haul the veteran's hook with economy so the opponent is taken off balance by a short pull.

name: Gnashing Backplate
description: Rake with one claw then the other along the plateau wind's line before the guard can reform.

name: Mayhem Rip
description: Open the opponent's guard with a hooked flick of the claw so the next stroke has a clear path.

name: Gnashing Scour
description: Rend with the full weight of the plateau wind in a single stroke that parts armor.

name: Mastering Raze
description: Pin the opponent with a veteran's patient grip and let him tire against the hooks.

name: Eviscerating Fingerblade
description: Throw rake after rake in a storm so fast that the opponent can only guard and never answer.
